1392216.summary: This is an unusually busy Seattle stadium-district game day. The Mariners host the Rangers at T-Mobile Park at 1:10 p.m. before the Seahawks' 5:20 p.m. season opener, and the Seahawks have confirmed that the Lumen Field North Lot and Mariners Garage will not be available for Seahawks parking. Public transit is the strongest option. The official Ticketmaster Tailgate opens at 2:00 p.m., while a sold-out Luke Bryan kickoff concert begins in the North Lot at 2:30 p.m. Fans inside Lumen Field will see the Super Bowl LX championship banner celebration, with Mike McCready performing the national anthem and Soundgarden featuring Taylor Momsen and McCready performing at halftime. Outside the stadium, several genuinely game-specific watch parties are confirmed around the Puget Sound region, including Ballard, West Seattle, Woodinville, Issaquah and Tacoma.

alerts.title: Mariners game will create a major stadium-district overlap
alerts.text: The Mariners play the Texas Rangers at T-Mobile Park at 1:10 p.m., only a few hours before the Seahawks' 5:20 p.m. kickoff. The Seahawks specifically warn fans to allow extra travel time.

alerts.title: North Lot and Mariners Garage unavailable for Seahawks parking
alerts.text: Because of the 1:10 p.m. Mariners game, the Lumen Field North Lot and Mariners Garage are unavailable for Seahawks parking. Existing parking pass holders have been sent relocation information by email.

alerts.title: Do not assume a special Sounder game train is running
alerts.text: The Seahawks' general transportation page says Sounder game trains operate for most games, but as of September 2 Sound Transit's official September event-service calendar does not list special Sounder service for the September 9 Seahawks game. Do not build your trip around a special game train unless Sound Transit publishes game-specific service.

alerts.title: Luke Bryan kickoff concert is sold out
alerts.text: USAA's Salute 250 Kickoff Concert in the Lumen Field North Lot is sold out. A concert ticket and an active Seahawks-Patriots game ticket are required. Gate 3 opens at 1:30 p.m., the concert starts at 2:30 p.m. and is scheduled to end at 3:45 p.m.

transportation.name: Link light rail
transportation.recommendation: Best all-around option for most fans because parking supply is unusually constrained.
transportation.details: Link provides direct access to the stadium district. Lumen Field identifies Stadium and International District/Chinatown as nearby stations. Line 1 connects the stadium area with communities north and south of Seattle, while expanded Link service also provides Eastside connections. Expect heavier-than-normal afternoon crowds because the Mariners game ends in the same stadium district before Seahawks pregame activities peak.

transportation.name: King County Metro
transportation.recommendation: Good option from Seattle neighborhoods and for connecting into the stadium district without parking.
transportation.details: More than 15 daily Metro routes stop within three blocks of Lumen Field. There is no dedicated Seahawks express gameday bus service, so use the regular weekday network and check the Metro Trip Planner before leaving. Downtown and SODO buses can be crowded around both the Mariners and Seahawks events.

transportation.name: Sound Transit Express buses
transportation.recommendation: Useful alternative for fans coming from Pierce, King and Snohomish counties, especially if a special Sounder train is not published.
transportation.details: The Seahawks transportation guide lists ST Express connections from areas including Everett, Tacoma, Federal Way, Bellevue, Redmond, Bothell, Issaquah and Woodinville, with downtown stops within walking distance of Lumen Field. Verify the September 9 weekday timetable for your route before traveling.

transportation.name: Sounder commuter rail
transportation.recommendation: Use only a regularly scheduled weekday train that fits your trip unless Sound Transit later publishes a game-specific schedule.
transportation.details: As of September 2, Sound Transit's official event-service calendar does not list a September 9 Seahawks special-event train. This is important because the Seahawks' generic transportation page says game trains operate for 'most' games rather than confirming this particular Wednesday night game.

transportation.name: Washington State Ferries
transportation.recommendation: A practical car-free option for Bainbridge Island and Bremerton fans.
transportation.details: Seattle-Bainbridge and Seattle-Bremerton ferries arrive at Colman Dock, within walking distance of Lumen Field. Because this is a Wednesday night game, verify the current WSF sailing schedule before committing to a return sailing after the game.

transportation.name: Bellair Sports Shuttle
transportation.recommendation: Worth considering for fans coming from Bellingham, Burlington or Marysville who want to avoid Seattle driving and parking.
transportation.details: Bellair is selling a game-specific round-trip Seahawks shuttle for September 9 at $49 per person. Scheduled departures are 12:30 p.m. from Bellingham, 1:15 p.m. from Burlington and 2:00 p.m. from Marysville, with a listed Lumen Field arrival of 3:20 p.m.

parking.name: Lumen Field North Lot
parking.details: Unavailable for this game because of the 1:10 p.m. Mariners game. Do not arrive expecting to purchase or use standard Seahawks parking here.

parking.name: Mariners Garage
parking.details: Unavailable for Seahawks parking because the Mariners host Texas at 1:10 p.m. Parking pass holders affected by the conflict have been sent relocation instructions by email.

parking.name: Lumen Field Garage
parking.details: The Seahawks state that on-site North Lot and Lumen Field Garage parking is presold on a season basis and is not available for single-game purchase; only pass holders are permitted on game day. StubHub parking passes are not accepted at the Lumen Field Garage.

parking.name: Area parking via SpotHero
parking.details: The Seahawks direct single-game drivers to SpotHero for nearby gameday parking. With two major stadium events overlapping on September 9, reserve before heading downtown rather than relying on drive-up availability.

parking.name: Tailgating on Lumen Field property
parking.details: Private tailgating is not permitted on Lumen Field property. Fans wanting a structured pregame should use the official Ticketmaster Tailgate or a verified off-property event.

timeline.details: T-Mobile Park will already be active next door, creating an unusual afternoon traffic and parking overlap.
For fans who already hold tickets to the sold-out USAA Salute 250 Kickoff Concert.
Official Seahawks pregame inside the Lumen Field Event Center with food, activities, music, merchandise and the Super Bowl LX trophy display.
Sold-out concert in the Lumen Field North Lot. A separate concert ticket plus an active game ticket are required.

timeline.event: Suites and Delta Sky360 Club open
timeline.details: Premium-entry areas open one hour before general stadium gates.
First autograph session inside Ticketmaster Tailgate.
Multiple Seahawks-listed performers begin around the venue, including music in Muckleshoot Heritage Plaza, the Muckleshoot Sports Lounge, T-Mobile Endzone and stadium concourses.
General stadium entry begins. With a championship banner celebration and large opening-night crowd expected, entering well before kickoff is recommended.
Second autograph session inside Ticketmaster Tailgate.

timeline.event: Luke Bryan concert scheduled to end
timeline.details: Concert attendees can then move toward regular stadium entry and their seats.

timeline.event: Super Bowl LX banner celebration and national anthem
timeline.details: The Seahawks will unveil their Super Bowl LX champions banner. Mike McCready of Pearl Jam is scheduled to perform the national anthem.
NFL Week 1 and a rematch of Super Bowl LX.
Soundgarden will perform with Taylor Momsen of The Pretty Reckless and Mike McCready of Pearl Jam.

tailgates.name: Ticketmaster Tailgate
tailgates.description: The official Seahawks pregame event. It is open to fans of all ages, with a 21+ Sports Bar area, gaming and kid-friendly activities, value-priced concessions, Seahawks merchandise and live music. Week 1 includes Seahawks Legends autograph sessions, a Super Bowl LX trophy photo opportunity, and a Taste-Off featuring $12 Sloppy Joe and Cuban Sandwich entries. The first 10,000 fans in Ticketmaster Tailgate receive a commemorative ticket.

tailgates.name: XPH Seahawks vs. Patriots Tailgate
tailgates.description: A verified off-property Xperience tailgate approximately a short walk south of Lumen Field. Tailgreeter lists the September 9 Patriots-Seahawks event with food, drinks and DJ sets.

watchParties.name: Tractor Tavern Seahawks Watch Party
watchParties.location: Tractor Tavern, 5213 Ballard Ave NW, Seattle, WA 98107
watchParties.description: The Tractor Tavern's own current event calendar lists a dedicated Seahawks Watch Party for the September 9 opener. This is a particularly useful Ballard option for fans avoiding the stadium district.

watchParties.name: Ounces Seahawks Season Kickoff Watch Party
watchParties.location: Ounces Taproom & Beer Garden, West Seattle
watchParties.description: Ounces is explicitly hosting the season opener from 5:00-8:30 p.m. with the game on three screens and game sound on. The venue advertises beer and food during the event.

watchParties.name: Synne Indoor Tailgate: Seahawks vs. Patriots
watchParties.location: Synne Cellars at Hollywood Schoolhouse, 14810 NE 145th Street, Suite B, Woodinville, WA 98072
watchParties.description: Synne Cellars is hosting a no-cover indoor Seahawks watch party in The Classroom with the game on all three TVs and sound on. Guests can buy Synne wine or local beer and may bring takeout or order from neighboring restaurants. Seating is first come, first served.
specials: Local Watts Brewing beer available in addition to Synne Cellars wine

watchParties.name: Wine Me Up Seahawks vs. Patriots Watch Party
watchParties.location: Wine Me Up, Gilman Village, 317 NW Gilman Blvd 30B, Issaquah, WA 98027
watchParties.description: A dedicated Seahawks-Patriots watch party from 5:00-8:00 p.m. with TVs throughout the venue and game sound. The event features a JJ's Soul Food game-day menu and a full wine and cocktail bar.

watchParties.name: Emerald Queen Casino Kickoff Night Watch Party
watchParties.location: Emerald Queen Casino Tacoma, 2920 E R Street, Tacoma, WA 98404
watchParties.description: EQC is explicitly hosting Seattle vs. New England. The Sportsbook has first-come, first-served seating, and the game will also be shown in the Event Center on a 40-foot screen with doors at 4:20 p.m. The event is free to attend. Players Club members can enter Free Play drawings tied to each quarter.
specials: Players Club members may enter drawings in which two winners after each quarter receive $250 in Free Play

stadiumTips.title: Arrive earlier than for a normal regular-season game
stadiumTips.details: This game combines the NFL season opener, a championship banner celebration, a sold-out pregame concert and a neighboring 1:10 p.m. Mariners game. General gates open at 3:30 p.m. for the 5:20 p.m. kickoff.

stadiumTips.title: Ticketmaster Tailgate has a Week 1 giveaway
stadiumTips.details: The first 10,000 fans entering Ticketmaster Tailgate will receive a commemorative ticket courtesy of Ticketmaster.

stadiumTips.title: Clear-bag policy is enforced
stadiumTips.details: Permitted clear bags may be no larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches. Small non-clear clutches or wallets may be no larger than 4.5 x 6.5 inches. Oversized bags will be denied entry. Walker's Lockers operates near the north and south entrances for Seahawks events.

stadiumTips.title: Have your mobile ticket ready before reaching the scanner
stadiumTips.details: Lumen Field recommends opening tickets in the Ticketmaster account or mobile wallet before reaching the self-scan turnstiles. Groups can scan all tickets and then proceed through the turnstile one at a time.

stadiumTips.title: Lumen Field is cashless
stadiumTips.details: Concessions, retail, parking and roaming vendors accept cards rather than cash. Cash-to-card kiosks are available for fans who need to convert cash to a prepaid card.

stadiumTips.title: Factory-sealed water is allowed
stadiumTips.details: Lumen Field permits factory-sealed non-flavored, non-sparkling water bottles and empty soft-sided plastic sports bottles. Many other outside beverages and hard-sided containers are prohibited.

stadiumTips.title: Use the new North Lot pedestrian pathway
stadiumTips.details: The Seahawks added a stamped terracotta pedestrian pathway connecting the base of the Weller Street Bridge with Stadium Gate 1, designed to improve pedestrian safety on event days.

stadiumTips.title: No private tailgating on Lumen Field property
stadiumTips.details: Lumen Field's Seahawks transportation guidance states that tailgating is not permitted on stadium property. Use the official Ticketmaster Tailgate or a verified nearby private event instead.

weather.summary: The current National Weather Service day-seven forecast for downtown Seattle calls for mostly sunny weather on Wednesday. Because the forecast is still at the edge of the reliable seven-day window, check again within 48 hours of kickoff for an evening-specific update.
weather.temperature: High near 72°F; Tuesday night low around 56°F
weather.precipitationChance: No measurable precipitation chance is currently specified for Wednesday in the NWS text forecast; conditions are listed as mostly sunny.
weather.wind: Not yet specified for Wednesday in the current NWS day-seven text forecast.
